newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 18.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan prepares next anti-gangster campaign.
Russian President Boris Yeltsin sacks security chief Alexander Lebed.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Parliament prepares to vote today on fourth nuclear power plant.
Police crack taxi crime ring specialising in robbing, raping women at night.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan to allow options trading between Taiwan dollar and foreign currencies.
Insurance companies target market in southern Taiwan.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Hopes rise for direct links between Taiwan, China.
Oil prices to be raised in stages, with a three percent hike in first stage.
